nameJa: チャットを連れて全画面へ
conceptNote: 通常の動画と外側のチャットから、チャットを内側に残した全画面へ移る変化を一つの矢印で示す。
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: entirely text-free Chrome Web Store tile explaining a browser extension through a before-to-after visual.
Create ONE finished landscape image with aspect ratio exactly 11:7, target 1760 x 1120. Use warm-white paper-flat background, near-black video rectangles, vivid red accent, cool-gray chat shapes. Crisp refined 2D editorial diagram, highly legible at 440 x 280. NO letters, NO words, NO digits, NO pseudo-writing.
Composition: a SMALL before diagram occupies the upper-left portion, with a dark wide video rectangle and a narrow gray chat column immediately OUTSIDE that video on its right. The before diagram is modest, at most one-third of the overall image width. The small video has a red play triangle, and the small separate chat has three tiny avatar circles and strokes.
A SINGLE clean red diagonal arrow from beside the small before diagram points down and right toward the large after diagram. No other arrows.
The LARGE after diagram dominates the lower two-thirds of the canvas: one wide near-black video rectangle taking roughly 85 percent of canvas width and 63 percent of canvas height. A red play triangle sits inside its left half. A comfortable light-gray chat card with circular avatars, rounded message strokes, blank input pill and small send triangle is now OVERLAID INSIDE the right side of that same large video. Chat about 27 percent of large video width, with visible dark video surrounding it.
Four white fullscreen L-shaped brackets enclose the ENTIRE large video rectangle INCLUDING its inset chat. Right-hand brackets are at the far OUTER RIGHT beyond chat, never at the chat's left edge. Thus the transformation is obvious: small video plus separate chat becomes fullscreen video with chat retained inside.
Careful layout, generous visual breathing room, strong geometric hierarchy, no ornamental background. Flat colors, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no devices, no browser controls, no scenery, no landscapes, no people, no watermarks. No text anywhere.
